findings: probe_account_window begins only on the exact official home. The actual fresh-password stall and denied navigation occur before that point; changing the observer cannot be claimed to fix that earlier transition.

The current observer stops permanently for its epoch on one two-second eval callback timeout, malformed callback JSON, or main-thread acknowledgement timeout. worker_epoch stays claimed, so a later callback or same-document recovery does not restart observation automatically.

The current completion branch emits youtube_account_completed before attempting native close, ignores the close result, and stops even if normal close fails. This diagnostic can therefore overstate completion.

Existing nonce, navigation/intent epoch, one-worker claim, exact-home predicate, fresh public LOGGED_IN observation, noninteractive predicate and120-second/120-observation bounds are essential and must remain.
proposedScope: Keep a single evaluation or main-thread action in flight. Wait for that same pending result in short bounded slices while checking shutdown, current nonce/epoch, exact home and the original overall deadline. Do not issue overlapping evaluation requests to compensate for a missing callback.

A missing callback cannot wait beyond the existing overall observer deadline. A returned malformed or unknown observation may be skipped with bounded delay and observation budget, but never treated as authenticated completion.

Measure the two-second freshness bound from eval issuance, not callback receipt, so a delayed browser callback cannot make an old observation look fresh. A stale observation must not confirm account state or close any window; discard it and obtain a fresh observation only after the previous action has finished and the original deadline still permits it. Recheck freshness before close after any account refresh work.

Call normal close only on the captured current native window after fresh intent-matching authentication and noninteractive official home. Log youtube_account_close_requested only after close returns Ok; separately log youtube_account_window_destroyed from the exact nonce-bound Destroyed callback without calling that event authentication success. Remove the premature youtube_account_completed event. Do not equate a queued close request with observed destruction.

On close failure, retain the account window and re-observe within the same deadline rather than reporting completion. Keep authentication confirmation deduplication so a close retry cannot repeatedly refresh playback or revise account state.

Use only fixed bounded diagnostic enums and booleans for timeout/invalid response/stale observation/dispatch failure/close failure/close-request acceptance. Log no browser callback body, arbitrary error text, raw URL, query, identity, cookie, token, password or authentication value payload. Preserve the existing per-flow diagnostic cap.

No navigation allowlist change, forced F5, automatic consent/security submission, profile change, CHZZK/SOOP change, or relaxation of the account-change recording admission gate belongs to this batch.
